name: s3
title: Amazon S3
description: Objects in an S3 bucket (or an S3-compatible store), listed and read; a dataset's rows can live under a prefix (location s3:<bucket>/<prefix>). Reads the AWS keys from this machine's credentials.

bucket.label: Bucket
bucket.hint: The bucket's name (the s3:// prefix is optional). This names WHICH remote account the source serves.

prefix.label: Prefix
prefix.hint: Leave empty for the whole bucket. S3 has no directories: a prefix is a query.

cache_root.label: Cache folder
cache_root.hint: Where downloaded bytes land. Defaults to this instance's own directory.

base_url.label: Endpoint
base_url.hint: An S3-compatible endpoint (MinIO, R2). Requests then address the bucket by path.
